segments.sn22.139:1.2: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.139:1.4: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ, tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.139:1.5: Vedanā aniccā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ;
segments.sn22.139:1.9: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
